title: Self-Supervised Learning for Soft-Constrained AC-OPF in Multiphase Distribution Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.31026v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper presents a self-supervised learning framework for fast, soft-constrained AC optimal power flow (OPF) in unbalanced multiphase distribution systems. The soft AC-OPF objective balances operating cost, renewable energy curtailment, and penalties for violating operating limits. A neural network predicts distributed energy resource (DER) setpoints conditioned on operating conditions, switch configurations, and objective weights. The predicted setpoints are then processed through a DER projection and differentiable AC power flow to enforce device limits and network equalities. The framework is trained by directly minimizing the AC-OPF objective, without optimal-solution labels. Experiments on 123-, 240-, and 906-bus systems yield mean objective gaps of 0.32%, 0.92%, and 0.56%, respectively, relative to IPOPT, across wide operating ranges. translated_title: 多相配电系统中软约束交流最优潮流的自监督学习
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种自监督学习框架，用于不平衡多相配电系统中快速、软约束的交流最优潮流（OPF）求解。该软约束AC-OPF目标函数平衡了运行成本、可再生能源削减以及违反运行约束的惩罚。神经网络基于运行条件、开关配置和目标权重来预测分布式能源（DER）的设定值。预测的设定值随后通过DER投影和可微分交流潮流计算进行处理，以强制执行设备限制和网络等式约束。该框架通过直接最小化AC-OPF目标函数进行训练，无需最优解标签。在123节点、240节点和906节点系统上的实验表明，在广泛的运行范围内，相对于IPOPT，平均目标函数间隙分别为0.32%、0.92%和0.56%。跨这些系统以及所评估的高负载/低发电和低负载/高发电场景……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需最优解标签的自监督学习框架，结合神经网络、DER投影和可微分交流潮流，实现多相配电系统中快速软约束的交流最优潮流求解，在123至906节点系统上与IPOPT相比平均目标函数间隙仅为0.32%-0.92%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a self-supervised learning framework that combines neural networks, DER projection, and differentiable AC power flow to solve soft-constrained AC-OPF in multiphase distribution systems without optimal-solution labels, achieving mean objective gaps of only 0.32%-0.92% compared to IPOPT across 123- to 906-bus systems.
